messages:
alex: Heads up — planning to roll chart redwood-api v2.7.0 → v2.8.0 canary in eu-west tonight during change window 23:00 UTC. Need pin on chart version + confirmation on rollback steps.

deploy-bot: @alex started canary rollout for release redwood-api chart=redwood-api v2.8.0 → 10% traffic on pool eu-west-1. Logs: https://ci.example/rels/1234

maria: Please pin values.yaml for the canary. Last time autoscaler minReplicas changed and caused flapping. Suggest set replicas.min=2 for canary.

sam_k: Agreed. Also propose we keep image tag pinned: image.tag=sha256:abcd1234 not :latest. Canary manifests below:
```yaml
replicaCount: 2
image:
  repository: ghcr.io/redwood/redux
  tag: sha256:abcd1234
autoscaling:
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 6
```

jin_park: Quick note — infra maintenance scheduled 23:30–00:15 UTC. If canary starts at 23:00 we overlap. Recommend starting at 21:30 or postpone to tomorrow. Who owns final signoff?

alex: Thanks, hadn't noticed maintenance. Let's move to 21:30 UTC. @maria @sam_k confirm you can do the rollout then.

maria: 21:30 works for me. I'll pin chart version in values and open the release PR.

deploy-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/helm-charts/pull/887 with pinned chartVersion: "2.8.0" and values overrides. CI checks queued.

sam_k: Rollback playbook (for quick copy):
- check pods: kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=redwood-api
- scale down canary: kubectl -n prod patch deployment redwood-api --patch '{"spec":{"replicas":0}}'
- revert helm: helm upgrade redwood-api redwood/redwood-api --reuse-values --version 2.7.0
- verify: ./scripts/verify-smoke.sh prod
Copy/paste:
```bash
helm upgrade redwood-api redwood/redwood-api --namespace prod --version 2.7.0 --reuse-values
kubectl rollout status deploy/redwood-api -n prod
```

jin_park: Add note: if KV cache mismatch observed, restart gateway pods after rollback:
```bash
kubectl rollout restart deploy/gateway -n prod
```

deploy-bot: Canary health check failed at 21:32:14 UTC — 3/10 instances reporting 5xx. Canary paused automatically. Details: https://ci.example/canaries/5678/error

alex: On it. Reverting to 2.7.0. @sam_k please run the rollback commands and post status. I'll notify SRE.

sam_k: Running helm revert now. Pasting logs:
```
upgrading release redwood-api to v2.7.0...
Release "redwood-api" has been upgraded. status: deployed
kubectl rollout status deploy/redwood-api -n prod: success
```

maria: Confirmed no 5xx after revert on traces. Marking incident as resolved. Opening postmortem thread.

alex: Good catch, thanks everyone. Follow-ups: add a canary memory limit to prevent crashloops, update our change window calendar to block infra maintenance overlap. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: Release redwood-api rollback completed by sam_k at 21:36:02 UTC. Canary aborted. CI/Deploy notes: https://ci.example/rels/1234/logs

sam_k: Ack. Will file a small PR with memory limit and chart version pin tests.
